mistake_reason: At step 16, BoxOfficeMojoData_Expert exhibits Loss of Conversation History (FM-1.4) by resetting the workflow and disregarding the previously retrieved and validated cached lists (which yielded 6 overlaps). The agent restarts the task as if no prior data existed and adopts the incomplete secondary worldwide list that omits "Onward." This context amnesia leads the team to recompute the overlap using the truncated worldwide list, resulting in an incorrect count of 5 instead of the correct 6.
